title: Especialista de Governança de TI
description:
Estamos conduzindo um processo confidencial para uma posição estratégica na área de Tecnologia da Informação. Buscamos um(a) Especialista de Governança de TI com experiência em frameworks, auditorias e gestão de processos, que atue de forma autônoma e estruturada na governança corporativa.


Sobre a oportunidade

Buscamos um(a) Especialista de Governança de TI para fortalecer nossa estrutura de tecnologia, garantindo a conformidade, eficiência e melhoria contínua dos processos da área. Essa posição tem papel estratégico na sustentação dos frameworks e controles de governança, com atuação direta em auditorias, políticas internas e indicadores de desempenho.


Principais responsabilidades

• Atuar na gestão de Governança de TI, respondendo a auditorias internas e externas.

• Assegurar conformidade com frameworks e normas como ISO 27000, COBIT e ITIL.

• Manter políticas, procedimentos e catálogos de serviços atualizados e revisados periodicamente.

• Acompanhar e consolidar indicadores de desempenho, SLA e cumprimento de processos.

• Conduzir análises de causa raiz e planos de ação de incidentes e mudanças.

• Apoiar programas de conscientização em segurança da informação e cibersegurança.

• Coordenar comitês técnicos, garantindo formalização de atas e evidências auditáveis.

• Promover a melhoria contínua dos processos e a padronização das práticas de governança.


Requisitos obrigatórios

• Formação superior em Gestão, Sistemas de Informação, Administração ou áreas correlatas.

• Certificação ou conhecimento em ITIL Foundation.

• Curso ou experiência com auditoria interna (ISO 9001 / 27000).

• Experiência comprovada em Governança de TI.

• Boa comunicação e postura para interação com consultorias e auditorias.

• Residência em São Paulo ou região.


Diferenciais

• Vivência com ServiceNow e monitoramento de indicadores de governança.

• Participação em programas de conscientização em segurança da informação.

• Conhecimento em gestão de mudanças, incidentes e problemas sob frameworks ITIL.

title: Leader-Merchant Informatization
description:
About Us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to transform food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage.

In less than one year, Keeta became an industry leader in Hong Kong, China. Soon after, we expanded into Saudi Arabia and are now present in more than 20 cities. Following our recent successful launch in Qatar, Kuwait and the UAE, we're bringing that same speed and innovation to more of the Middle East, and to Brazil.


Job Responsibilities

  1. Team Management and Deliverables: Responsible for managing a local Keeta team of approximately 30-40 people in Brazil, responsible for uploading and verifying all merchant information, ensuring data efficiency, completeness, and accuracy. This requires balancing limited resources and delivering high-quality team results on time.
  2. Mechanism and Process Development: Establish comprehensive internal and external collaboration workflows and oversight mechanisms, continuously optimizing processes to ensure the team accurately and efficiently serves business needs.
  3. Core Metric Monitoring: Monitor and report key onboarding metrics, proactively identify and resolve issues to ensure a smooth onboarding experience for merchants.
  4. Team Collaboration: Work closely with sales, compliance, and product teams to streamline the onboarding process and meet merchant needs.
  5. Team Development and Capacity Building: Develop training materials and conduct onboarding training for new employees and merchants as needed.


Job Requirements

  1. Highly responsible and unwaveringly committed to achieving goals and results.
  2. Effective in resource management and problem-solving.
  3. A strong learner, eager to continuously acquire new skills and adapt to a constantly changing business environment.
  4. A proactive team player who supports colleagues and enhances team efficiency through excellent communication skills.
  5. Native Portuguese speaker, fluent in English (listening, speaking, reading, and writing).
  6. Experience in merchant operations support is preferred.


Why Join Keeta

Keeta is redefining the future of food delivery with a bold vision and innovative spirit. As a fast-scaling brand under Meituan's global ambition, we offer a unique blend of stability and startup energy, providing boundless opportunities for personal and professional growth. Whether you want to specialize in your field or gain cross-functional experience, Keeta empowers you to take charge of your career.

As we expand globally, we are committed to building a workplace that reflects our unique culture while incorporating global best practices. You'll be part of a company that's transforming the delivery industry while supporting local communities, empowering merchants, and delivering outstanding customer experiences.

At Keeta, you'll collaborate with a passionate and pragmatic global team across over 57 countries, bringing diverse perspectives that drive creativity and innovation. We believe diversity is our strength and it pushes us to deliver better solutions for our customers and partners in Hong Kong, Saudi Arabia, and beyond.

Keeta offers limitless career growth and equal development opportunities, empowering you to grow as the company grows. Every day presents an opportunity for you to make a meaningful impact, grow professionally, and be part of something extraordinary. You'll thrive in a dynamic environment where every contribution is valued. Together, let's build the future of food delivery.

title: Supervisor de manutenção predial
description:
RESUMO DO CARGO:

Supervisiona e realiza trabalhos técnicos e mecânicos que garantem que os ambientes internos e externos dos prédios, terrenos, áreas comuns e comodidades da comunidade atendam aos padrões da Empresa em relação à limpeza, aparência, segurança e funcionalidade geral.


PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES:

• Auxilia e executa ordens de serviço geradas por solicitações dos moradores, bem como manutenção de rotina na comunidade, diagnosticando a origem ou causa do defeito ou problema e realizando os reparos de acordo com as políticas, procedimentos, normas de segurança e exigências do código estabelecidos.

• Supervisiona e conclui o processo de preparação (“make-ready”) das unidades desocupadas para locação e novos moradores, realizando a inspeção pré-desocupação, criando uma lista de manutenção necessária, agendando fornecedores e prestadores de serviço conforme necessário, adquirindo os materiais e suprimentos necessários, realizando todas as tarefas de manutenção e inspecionando o trabalho concluído.

• Desenvolve padrões para a limpeza e aparência geral das áreas externas da comunidade, comodidades, fachadas dos edifícios, interiores das unidades prontas para locação, corredores, calçadas, placas, escritório de locação, áreas centrais de lixo, estacionamentos e outras construções e áreas comuns, garantindo que reflitam a alta qualidade da comunidade e os padrões da Greystar.

• Inspeciona periodicamente o trabalho realizado por outros membros da equipe de manutenção para avaliar a eficácia das políticas e procedimentos e desenvolver planos de ação corretiva conforme necessário.

• Inspeciona periodicamente o trabalho realizado por empreiteiros, fornecedores e outros prestadores de serviços para verificar se os serviços, materiais e mão de obra atendem aos padrões de qualidade, escopo e especificações exigidas.

• Mantém inventário adequado de peças de reposição e materiais de manutenção, trabalhando com o Gerente da Comunidade para encomendar suprimentos e ferramentas conforme necessário, respeitando os limites orçamentários.

• Executa os procedimentos de manutenção preventiva mensalmente conforme descrito no Manual de Políticas e Procedimentos.

• Apoia programas de economia e controle de despesas consertando, sempre que possível, ao invés de substituir peças, evitando desperdício de materiais e suprimentos e utilizando ferramentas e equipamentos corretamente.

• Realiza reuniões regulares de segurança da Greystar, garante que todas as fichas MSDS estejam atualizadas e acessíveis, e mantém-se informado sobre todas as exigências e legislações de segurança da OSHA e outras entidades para garantir a conformidade da comunidade.


CONHECIMENTOS BÁSICOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES:

• Os ocupantes do cargo devem fornecer suas próprias ferramentas manuais, salvo quando proibido pela legislação estadual, e devem ter conhecimento e habilidades no uso e manutenção seguros de ferramentas manuais, elétricas, equipamentos mecânicos e dispositivos de medição.

• Capacidade demonstrada de aplicar princípios de raciocínio lógico para definir e corrigir problemas.

• Proficiência em atendimento ao cliente e habilidades de comunicação interpessoal para interagir eficazmente com moradores, clientes, colegas de equipe e outros contatos profissionais, respondendo com cortesia a perguntas e solicitações e mantendo a calma ao lidar com problemas.

• Capacidade comprovada de ler, escrever e se comunicar de forma eficaz para representar a gestão da empresa em funções de apoio, atuar como primeiro ponto de contato para colegas de equipe internos e visitantes externos, e responder a perguntas relacionadas às políticas operacionais do departamento.

• Proficiência demonstrada em programas de internet, processamento de texto, planilhas e gerenciamento de banco de dados para manter registros e desenvolver informações para uso do gestor. (Experiência com sistemas de gestão imobiliária é preferida.)

• Capacidade de operar máquinas básicas de escritório, como copiadoras, fax, calculadoras, máquinas de selos postais e sistemas telefônicos com várias linhas.

• Habilidades matemáticas necessárias para somar, subtrair, multiplicar e dividir números, decimais e frações para revisar e preencher documentos financeiros, administrativos e legais.

• Ensino Médio completo, GED ou experiência e/ou treinamento relacionado.


LICENÇAS OU CERTIFICAÇÕES EXIGIDAS:

• Os ocupantes do cargo devem possuir todas as certificações exigidas pelas jurisdições estaduais e locais.


VIAGENS / EXIGÊNCIAS FÍSICAS:

• Os membros da equipe trabalham em ambiente de escritório ou remoto. Nenhuma exigência física especial é necessária.

• Viagens raras ou ocasionais podem ser exigidas para participar de reuniões de negócios, treinamentos ou outras situações necessárias para o cumprimento de algumas ou todas as responsabilidades diárias deste cargo.


Sobre a Greystar

A Greystar é uma empresa global líder, totalmente integrada, do setor imobiliário, oferecendo expertise em gestão de propriedades, gestão de investimentos, desenvolvimento e serviços de construção nos setores de habitação para locação de padrão institucional, logística e ciências da vida. Com sede em Charleston, Carolina do Sul, a Greystar gerencia e opera mais de US$ 290 bilhões em imóveis em 247 mercados globalmente, com escritórios em toda a América do Norte, Europa, América do Sul e região da Ásia-Pacífico. A Greystar é a maior operadora de apartamentos nos Estados Unidos, administra mais de 857.400 unidades/leitos em todo o mundo e possui uma robusta plataforma institucional de gestão de investimentos, com mais de US$ 76 bilhões em ativos sob gestão, incluindo mais de US$ 34 bilhões em ativos em desenvolvimento. A Greystar foi fundada por Bob Faith em 1993 com o objetivo de se tornar uma prestadora de serviços de classe mundial no setor imobiliário residencial para locação. Para saber mais, acesse .

title: Analista Pl - Qualidade (Auditoria) - Pesquisa Nacional - IDOR SP
description:
Fundado em 2010 no Rio de Janeiro, o Instituto D’Or de Pesquisa e Ensino (IDOR) é uma organização sem fins lucrativos que tem como objetivo contribuir para a evolução da ciência, de forma a melhorar a condição de vida humana. Para isso, combina pesquisa de ponta, capacitação profissional e desenvolvimento tecnológico na área da saúde. Sua principal mantenedora é a Rede D’Or São Luiz (RDSL), maior rede hospitalar privada do Brasil.

Desde sua criação, o IDOR valoriza a ciência e se mantém atento às necessidades do país na área da saúde, mobilizando seus recursos e estimulando seus pesquisadores na busca de soluções para problemas atuais e futuros.

Desta forma, o Instituto trouxe importantes contribuições para a saúde pública nacional e internacional, como no entendimento do papel do vírus Zika nas malformações do sistema nervoso e nas pesquisas voltadas para o enfrentamento da pandemia de covid-19.

A excelência da pesquisa desenvolvida no IDOR viabiliza inúmeras parcerias internacionais e centenas de publicações em revistas científicas de grande prestígio. Além disso, o Instituto também contribui significativamente para a formação de profissionais da área da saúde nas diferentes esferas do ensino, incluindo graduação, pós-graduação stricto sensu, residência médica e multiprofissional, aperfeiçoamento e cursos de capacitação, atividades que deram origem à Faculdade IDOR de Ciências Médicas, fundada em 2017.


Requisitos

A área de Qualidade em Pesquisa Clínica é responsável por assegurar que todos os processos relacionados a ensaios clínicos sejam conduzidos em conformidade com normas nacionais e internacionais, garantindo a integridade científica dos dados, a segurança dos participantes e a aderência regulatória. Atuamos na padronização de processos, execução de auditorias, monitoramento de indicadores e implementação de melhorias contínuas.


  • Formação superior em Enfermagem, Farmácia, Biomedicina, Medicina ou áreas correlatas da saúde;

  • Vivência prévia em auditorias de pesquisa clínica;
  • Conhecimento em auditorias internacionais (FDA, EMA, PMDA);
  • Desejável conhecimento de sistemas eletrônicos (eTMF, CTMS, EDC, eISF);

title: Senior Technical Manager – Fixed Networks & Infrastructure
description:
About This Role

We're seeking an exceptional Senior Technical Manager who will architect and orchestrate mission-critical telecommunications infrastructure that powers millions of connections across Latin America. This is your opportunity to drive technological innovation, lead high-performing teams, and shape the future of fixed network solutions.


What You'll Do


Strategic Leadership

  • Architect and deploy carrier-grade fixed network solutions across fiber optics, GPON/EPON, SDN/NFV, and bearer network ecosystems

  • Drive technical strategy for large-scale network transformation projects aligned with business objectives


Operational Excellence

  • Execute logical deployment strategies including provisioning, service activation, and zero-touch deployment frameworks
  • Command Tier 3/4 technical support operations with root cause analysis and incident elimination protocols
  • Optimize warranty lifecycle and spares inventory ensuring <99% equipment availability
  • Delivery measurable improvements: 99.99%+ uptime, 40%+ MTTR reduction, enhanced operational efficiency


Technical Mastery

  • Eliminate network bottlenecks through proactive capacity planning and infrastructure optimization
  • Orchestrate vendor relationships, negotiate contracts, and enforce SLA compliance
  • Establish comprehensive technical documentation and deployment playbooks
  • Champion adoption of 5G integration, edge computing, and automated network management


What You Bring


Required Experience

  • Experience in telecommunications infrastructure and in senior technical leadership;
  • Proven track record deploying large-scale networks (1MM+ subscribers or equivalent);
  • Expert-level troubleshooting across physical and logical layers;
  • Demonstrated success managing technical support operations and ITIL frameworks.


Bearer Network Expertise (Must Have)

  • Optical Transport: DWDM, OTN (OTU/ODU), SDH/SONET, WDM systems, EDFA, dispersion management
  • Fiber Infrastructure: Dark fiber, OPGW, aerial/underground deployment, OTDR testing
  • Metro & Aggregation: Carrier Ethernet (MEF), MPLS-TP, Metro WDM, PTN
  • IP/MPLS Backbone: Core routing, MPLS VPN (L2/L3), traffic engineering, segment routing, BGP/ISIS
  • Access Networks: PON (GPON/XG-PON/XGS-PON/NG-PON2), Active Ethernet, FTTx architectures
  • Microwave Transmission: P2P links, spectrum planning, link budget calculations


Technical Skills

  • Network protocols: BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, RSVP, LDP, TCP/IP, SIP, VoIP
  • Logical provisioning systems, EMS/NMS platforms, network orchestration tools
  • Advanced diagnostics: OTDR, OSA, BERT, spectrum analyzers, protocol analyzers
  • OSS/BSS systems, monitoring tools (Nagios, Zabbix, SolarWinds), ServiceNow, Jira
  • Automation: Ansible, Python scripting
  • Cloud-native architectures, Docker/Kubernetes, DevOps methodologies
  • Multi-vendor platforms: ZTE, Huawei, Ciena, Nokia, Cisco optical/routing equipment


Deployment & Operations

  • Complex cutover management and phased rollout strategies with zero service disruption
  • Multi-tier support framework design and escalation matrix implementation
  • Data-driven spares management and predictive maintenance programs
  • Vendor negotiation and RMA cycle management
  • Process automation and provisioning timeline reduction


Leadership Capabilities

  • Proven ability to identify and develop high-potential talent, assessing how candidates think and solve problems under pressure
  • Building high-performing teams in fast-paced, demanding environments
  • Strategic mindset balancing operational needs with long-term architectural vision
  • Cross-functional collaboration across deployment, support, procurement, and vendor management


Education & Certifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent.
  • MBA in Project Management is a plus.
  • Certifications highly valued: CCNP/CCIE (Service Provider), JNCIP-SP, ITIL Foundation/Expert
  • Bilingual: Portuguese (native/fluent) and English (advanced communication as primary working language)


Plus/Nice to Have

  • Wireless network experience (4G/5G RAN, microwave backhaul, small cells, DAS)
  • Wireless-wireline convergence architectures
  • Spectrum management and RF planning knowledge


Why Join Us


✅ Strategic Influence: Direct access to executive leadership shaping company direction

✅ Technical Autonomy: Select technologies, design architectures, and optimize operations

✅ Operational Impact: Transform deployment, support, and maintenance organization-wide

✅ Market Leadership: Partner with tier-1 carriers on

title: NGS Scientific & Technical Operations Manager – LATAM
description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY



MGI is at the forefront of genomics innovation, delivering cutting-edge sequencing technologies and advancing life sciences research worldwide. We are dedicated to enabling affordable, effective healthcare solutions and expanding our impact across the Americas. If you’re passionate about genomics, NGS, and making a real difference in healthcare and research, join us on this exciting journey toward accessible innovation for all.



ABOUT THE ROLE



We are seeking an experienced NGS Scientific & Technical Operations Manager – LATAM to lead our Scientists, Field Service Engineers, Bioinformatics, Quality, and Customer Experience teams across Latin America. This leadership role requires a solid scientific foundation in molecular biology, genetics, bioinformatics, or related life sciences, combined with strong operational and people management skills. You will ensure exceptional customer support, technical excellence, and continuous improvement across all post-sales service functions in the region.



RESPONSIBILITIES



  • Report directly to the Head of LATAM and collaborate closely with Global Technical Support, Training, Sales, and Service Operations leaders.
  • Lead and mentor a multidisciplinary team including Field Application Scientists, Field Service Engineers, Field Bioinformaticians, and Customer Support professionals.
  • Oversee customer satisfaction and operational efficiency, ensuring that service requests, installations, and technical issues are managed effectively and within expected timelines.
  • Define individual training and development needs across the technical team and recommend staffing plans and hiring strategies.
  • Establish measurable goals and performance indicators (e.g., response time, first-time resolution, quality metrics).
  • Manage regional service operations including resource allocation, travel budgets, spare part inventory, and field reporting.
  • Ensure accurate communication and coordination between LATAM and global operations, cascading critical updates and initiatives.
  • Serve as the technical and operational lead for the Customer Experience Center (CEC) and Demo Lab, driving technical demonstrations and customer engagement.
  • Maintain alignment with global quality standards, ensuring compliance, traceability, and continuous improvement of support processes.
  • Able to support and coordinate teams across the LATAM time zones.


QUALIFICATIONS



  • Master’s degree (or higher) in Genetics, Molecular Biology, Biotechnology, Bioinformatics, or a related field.
  • Strong academic background or work experience in NGS (Next Generation Sequencing) is highly preferred.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in technical support, field service, or applications management, ideally within the genomics or life sciences industry.
  • Proven leadership and people management skills, with experience guiding technical and scientific teams.
  • Excellent communication and organizational abilities; capable of navigating global structures and driving results across functions.
  • Willingness to travel regionally and internationally, including occasional training or collaboration trips to China.


PAY RANGE AND COMPENSATION PACKAGE



MGI offers a competitive and comprehensive benefits package to employees and their dependents (including domestic partners), which includes:



  • Medical and dental coverage
  • Travel insurance
  • Meal vouchers
  • Gym allowance


EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT



MGI is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

  • Solid experience in software development, with a strong focus on AI and conversational solutions.
  • Expertise in programming Low Code (Dialogue Flow, IBM Watson), NodeJS, JavaScript, Golang ou outras linguagens microsservices
  • Experience with NLP technologies and frameworks (e.g., Rasa, Dialogflow, or similar).
  • Strong understanding of microservices, cloud technologies (AWS, GCP, Azure), and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).

  • Exceptional problem-solving skills and a passion for developing innovative solutions.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Our corporate language is English, please submit your application in English
  • Experience with real-time messaging platforms and API integrations.
  • Knowledge of CI/CD practices and tools.
  • Familiarity with agile development methodologies and project management tools.



Benefits

Sinch is a global company composed of people from different countries and cultures. Our benefits adjust regionally to support employees and help them to thrive in every stage of life. We offer valuable benefits and resources, including health and life insurance, a flexible work environment, retirement savings plans, and more.


  • STAY HEALTHY: We cover 100% of medical and dental plans for Sinchers and eligible dependents through Bradesco Saúde.
  • FLEXIBLE BENEFITS: With the Caju flexible benefit card, our Sinchers can choose to use benefits on food, education, and home office assistance.
  • FAMILY FIRST: Our Sinchers can enjoy paid maternity leave for 180 days and paternity leave for 30 days. Plus, we provide daycare assistance for kids up to five years old.
  • EVERYDAY WELLBEING: We partner with Wellhub to help Sinchers access gyms and wellness options.
  • SECURE YOUR FUTURE: Our Partnership with Prudential life insurance provides coverage for all Sinchers in the events of unexpected absences, serious illness, accidents, and disabilities.
  • DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION: We offer annual reimbursements for certain expenses related to disabilities and/or transgender needs.
  • TAKE A BREAK: Our Sinchers can take a day off on their birthday to celebrate with their loved ones.


Our Hiring Process

In Sinch, we are committed to following a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and non-discriminatory. Our Talent Acquisition team, together with hiring managers and the rest of the interviewing team, persistently work towards identifying the candidates that best fit each open job, based on Sinch' s hiring needs and candidates' career expectations. We encourage applications from strong candidates with relevant professional backgrounds for this role. Not all applicants will meet all job requirements exactly! Even if you do not meet all job requirements, don't let that stop you from considering Sinch for the next step in your career. We are always open to candidates that could bring new ideas and perspectives to Sinch!

title: Product Designer - Sênior
description:
PRODUCT DESIGNER

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.

Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.

Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.

Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

Como Product Designer, você será responsável por conduzir processos de Discovery e Design de Experiência, transformando problemas complexos em soluções intuitivas, consistentes e centradas no usuário. Sua missão será conectar estratégia, dados e usabilidade para desenhar produtos digitais que gerem impacto real para o negócio e para as pessoas.


Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Conduzir processos de Discovery, aplicando metodologias como benchmark, canvas, pesquisas com usuários, testes de usabilidade, análises heurísticas e hierarquia da informação para propor e definir jornadas consistentes;
  • Criar o layout de fluxos de navegação e comunicações a serem apresentados no site, desenhar wireframes, protótipos interativos e interfaces visuais responsiva;
  • Garantir consistência visual, de informação e de usabilidade em todos os produtos digitais;
  • Participar de agendas colaborativas com times de produto, tecnologia e dados, alinhando objetivos estratégicos;
  • Contribuir para a evolução e manutenção do design system da empresa.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Experiência comprovada como UX/UI Designer, com portfólio relevante;
  • Domínio de ferramentas como Figma, Adobe XD, Sketch ou similares;
  • Conhecimento em Design Thinking, Lean UX e metodologias centradas no usuário;
  • Familiaridade com princípios de acessibilidade e design inclusivo;
  • Capacidade analítica para interpretar dados e traduzir insights em soluções de design;
  • Excelente comunicação e habilidade de colaboração com times multidisciplinares;
  • Disponibilidade para atuação híbrida em São Paulo/SP.


Você pode se destacar se:

  • Já tiver atuado com metodologias ágeis;
  • Tiver experiência com gerenciadores de tarefas;
  • Já tiver atuado em consultoria ou prestação de serviços;
  • Tiver perfil analítico, organizado e propositivo, com autogestão e foco em qualidade das entregas.

O que oferecemos aos nossos Rethinkers?


Básico que a gente ama

  • Cartão Caju para usar como quiser nos benefícios de alimentação e home office
  • Day-off no aniversário
  • Kit de onboarding com todas as ferramentas essenciais e mimos exclusivos para Rethinkers


Saúde e bem-estar

  • Auxílio bem-estar mensal
  • Convênio médico Bradesco (100% custeado pela Rethink, com cobertura nacional)
  • Assistência odontológica
  • Saúde mental com a plataforma Conexa Saúde
  • Wellhub para cuidar do corpo em movimento
  • On Happy para planejar suas viagens à lazer
  • Escritórios em Belo Horizonte e Ipatinga prontos para te receber


Carreira e desenvolvimento

  • Plataforma interna com cursos de hard e soft skills
  • Oportunidades reais de crescimento em um ambiente que valoriza o aprendizado contínuo

Como funciona o nosso processo seletivo?

  1. Inscrição
  2. Você começa sua jornada cadastrando seu perfil por aqui.
  3. Bate-papo com People
  4. Uma conversa leve para conhecermos você, sua história e seus objetivos — e te apresentarmos nossa cultura.
  5. Entrevista técnica com liderança
  6. Hora de mergulhar nas suas habilidades e experiências.

title: Senior Business Continuity Analyst (BCM)
description:
Purpose of the Position

An Asian financial institution, recognized as one of the largest and among the leading banks worldwide, with a strong presence across the Americas, Europe, and Asia. In Brazil, the institution focuses on corporate and investment banking, providing clients with tailored financial solutions.


With a global reputation for stability and long-term relationships, the institution continues to invest in innovation, cybersecurity, and sustainability, reinforcing its commitment to responsible growth and the protection of client interests in a rapidly evolving financial landscape.


The main idea of this role is to protect the institution’s ability to deliver critical banking services during disruption by owning and advancing the BCM – Business Continuity Management program processes. This is a hands-on, orchestration-heavy position that translates global continuity standards into effective local execution and audit-ready evidence.

Concretely, the role:

  • Leads the BCM lifecycle end-to-end: conducts BIAs (criticality, dependencies, RTO/RPO), maintains BCPs, and plans/coordinates tests (e.g., DR/switch-over validations, contingency site, VDI/endpoint readiness, evacuation drills, call tree), including out-of-hours windows.
  • Turns results into decisions: surfaces risks, residual exposures, and disclaimers to risk committees; drives lessons learned and closes open issues with robust documentation and owners/dates/evidence.
  • Connects BCM to the broader non-financial risk picture: interfaces with Operational Incidents, Vendor Risk, Products & Services, and RCSA so that continuity risks and control gaps are consistently identified, tracked, and remediated.
  • Bridges global and local: adapts global policy/standards to Brazil’s context, ensuring regulatory fit (BACEN) without diluting control integrity.
  • Influences without formal authority: engages senior stakeholders (e.g., Treasury and Operations leaders) to prioritize continuity activities, align on test windows, and validate outcomes; partners with IT/IS to validate DR without performing technical changes.


Main Challenges and Assignments

  • Operate the existing Business Continuity framework while continuously improving its maturity, expanding coverage, and strengthening evidence quality.
  • Organize and document activities using spreadsheets and manual controls, ensuring that all records are audit-ready and compliant with internal and external requirements.
  • Plan, coordinate, and lead continuity tests, including out-of-hours exercises, anticipating risks, resolving issues on the spot, and making sound, well-reasoned decisions.
  • Adapt global policies and methodologies to the Brazilian regulatory context, maintaining alignment with global standards and full compliance with BACEN requirements.
  • Engage and influence critical business areas, such as Treasury and Operations, to secure collaboration and prioritization of BCM activities without direct authority.
  • Map critical processes, conduct Business Impact Analyses (BIA), and maintain updated Business Continuity Plans (BCP).
  • Develop, update, and review continuity policies, standards, and procedures, while supporting the management of open issues, regulatory requirements, and action plans.
  • Deliver training to teams and managers on continuity and disaster recovery procedures, proactively monitor external events and news for potential risks
  • This role will also involve executing other operational risk programs such as Operational Incident Management, Vendor/Product & Service Risk Management, etc.


Experience and Professional Qualifications

  • Bring solid experience gained over several years in financial institutions, with a proven track record in Business Continuity Management, including BIA, BCP, and continuity testing.
  • Demonstrate strong knowledge of operational resilience practices, with exposure to RCSA, operational incident management, and vendor/third-party risk.
  • Be comfortable coordinating with IT and Information Security (IS) teams during disaster recovery validations, leading and validating outcomes without performing the technical execution.
  • Possess proficiency in Excel for data analysis and tracking, and PowerPoint for building clear, executive-level presentations and reports.
  • Communicate effectively in English at a level to interact with global stakeholders and follow corporate standards.
  • Hold a degree in Business, Engineering, Information Systems/Computer Science, Risk Management, or a related field.
  • Knowledge of Bank Policies and Regulations, familiarity with cyber risk policies, procedures, and regulations, and the ability to review and ensure compliance with these requirements (Differential). Bring additional exposure to ISO 22301 standards, experience with tools such as Visio or Power BI/Power Query, and professional certifications in business continuity or disaster recovery (e.g., CBCP, DRII, BRCCI). (Differential)


Behavioral Skills

  • Executive communication & influence – Engages effectively with senior stakeholders, articulates complex topics in a clear, concise manner, and secures alignment in risk committees.
  • Proactivity & ownership – Demonstrates a self-starter mindset, acting hands-on and taking full responsibility for driving initiatives to completion.
  • Organization, discipline & critical thinking – Maintains audit-ready documentation with rigor and structure, while applying analytical thinking and sound judgment to make timely, well-reasoned decisions.
  • Collaboration & resilience – Partners seamlessly with Non-Tech areas and IT/IS, showing adaptability and composure under pressure, and adjusting course when unexpected challenges arise.

title: Desenvolvedor Full Stack Sênior & Líder Técnico
description:

Esta é uma oportunidade desafiadora para quem busca atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, com tecnologia de ponta e alto impacto técnico e estratégico.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Projetar e implementar novas funcionalidades em sistemas front-end e back-end utilizando tecnologias modernas de desenvolvimento web.

  • Realizar revisões de código, assegurar a qualidade do software e orientar membros juniores da equipe.
  • Liderar cerimônias ágeis (como sprint planning, daily meetings, retrospectives) e alinhar entregas aos objetivos técnicos e de negócio.
  • Investigar e resolver problemas complexos que afetam sistemas em larga escala, propondo soluções inovadoras e sustentáveis.



Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência relevante com desenvolvimento de software.
  • Stack obrigatória: C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core Web API + Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, CSS .
  • Experiência avançada com Entity Framework , Microsoft SQL Server e ajuste de desempenho de consultas e bancos de dados.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com sistemas distribuídos e padrões de mensageria assíncrona (ex: RabbitMQ, Kafka).
  • Conhecimento em IIS , serviços Microsoft Azure e arquitetura de sistemas corporativos.
  • Atuação prévia em domínios de negócio complexos, como commodity trading , finanças ou logística, será considerado um diferencial.


O que Oferecemos

  • Integração com equipes globais e projetos de grande escala.

title: Payroll Manager
description:
ABOUT THE WELLA COMPANY

Together, WE enable individuals to look, feel, and be their true selves.

Wella Company is one of the world’s leading beauty companies, comprised of a family of iconic brands such as Wella Professionals, Clairol, OPI, Nioxin and ghd. With 6,000 employees globally, presence in over 100 countries, Wella Company and its brands enable consumers to look, feel, and be their true selves. As innovators in the hair and nail industry, Wella Company empowers its people to delight consumers, inspire beauty professionals, engage communities, and deliver sustainable growth to its stakeholders.

For additional information about the Wella Company please visit


THE ROLE:

Are you passionate about driving efficient, people-focused processes and delivering operational excellence? Wella is seeking a People Operations Lead to take ownership of a key HR function across multiple country clusters (Mexico, Brazil and Argentina). This role plays a critical part in ensuring best-in-class HR operations, compliance, and employee experience, while partnering closely with regional and local People teams.


What You’ll Own & Drive:

  • Lead end-to-end People Operations for a cluster of countries, including payroll and HR administration;
  • Ensure compliance with local labor laws and internal policies;
  • Manage employment documentation across the employee lifecycle (contracts, onboarding packs, exit letters, etc.);
  • Support mobility documentation and relocation processes;
  • Maintain accurate data in HR systems for payroll and reporting;
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to ensure timely and precise payroll cycles;
  • Continuously improve and streamline People Ops processes across countries;
  • Manage the People inbox and respond to employee queries with empathy and efficiency;
  • Administer benefits and ensure compliance with local regulations;
  • Support compensation processes including salary reviews, bonuses, and ad hoc payments;
  • Partner with payroll vendors and finance teams to meet payroll deadlines;
  • Keep People Ops documentation audit-ready and legally compliant;
  • Be the go-to expert for employee queries on payroll, benefits, and HR admin;
  • Reconcile payroll with Finance and manage GL codes;
  • Contribute to People Ops projects and support your team with passion and drive.


What You Bring:


Must-Haves:

  • Solid experience in People Operations, ideally across multiple countries;
  • Strong payroll expertise, especially in Brazil and Mexico;
  • Experience working with ADP payroll systems (GV module);
  • Solid background in HR administration and data accuracy;
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word);
  • High ownership mindset, detail-oriented, and solution-driven;
  • Collaborative communicator and team player;
  • Organized, deadline-focused, and structured in approach;
  • Ability to mentor and support team members;
  • Fluent in English, Portuguese, and Spanish .


Nice-to-Haves:

  • Experience with SuccessFactors;
  • Background in building People teams from the ground up;
  • Process-oriented mindset with a passion for automation and simplification.


EEO OPPORTUNITIES

We offer equal employment opportunity to qualified individuals without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

We strongly believe that cultivating a diverse workplace gives a company strength. The combination of unique skills, abilities, experiences and backgrounds creates an environment that produces extraordinary results. EOE Minorities/Females/Protected Veterans/Disabled.

title: Talent Acquisition Manager
description:
Why choose us?


Page Outsourcing is one of the fastest growing Global Outsourced providers, having more than doubled its headcount in the past 18 months to support major clients across UK, North America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Latin America. This unprecedented expansion is due to our unique positioning within the global outsourcing industry and our ability to offer tailored, multi-regional outsourcing solutions, across the full total talent spectrum. Underpinned by our best-in-class Page Group infrastructure, we have an unmatched opportunity to deliver industry-leading performance.


What will you be doing?


You’ll be working, embedded in our client’s team, utilising their systems to deliver best-in-class hiring outcomes across a wider program or part of their business. You will own the recruitment strategy and be responsible for development, leadership and oversight of a team of recruiters supporting the client. You will demonstrate the ability to prioritise and manage your own workload in addition to supporting the team of recruiters you will be responsible for leading and developing. You'll be tasked with building and managing excellent relationships with hiring managers, maximising contract performance, while achieving all aspects of the service level agreement. You’ll work with our clients, helping to deliver their workforce plans, delivering outstanding experiences in line with the Page Outsourcing Values.


Key Activities


  • Build and maintain excellent working relationships with all client hiring managers and departments to ensure a smooth and timely recruitment process
  • Liaise with on-site contacts to understand and qualify hiring requirements
  • To generate and effectively manage candidate applications, ensuring a positive candidate experience
  • Innovative use of sourcing tools maximising applications and efficient screening of all applicants as we shortlist.
  • Negotiate starter offers and arrange related paperwork
  • Lead team to deliver on recruitment process and support (e.g. scheduling, compliance, governance, etc.)
  • Leadership, coaching and management of Recruiters and supporting Talent Sourcing partners and Talent Sourcing Co-Ordinators (onsite or remote)
  • Align on hiring strategies and best practices to ensure successful hiring outcomes
  • Effective use of reporting to develop and track the performance of the team in support of the client
  • Ensure full compliance of all data entered into the database, and ensure candidate MI is kept current and correct to allow for Market Intel reporting
  • Comply fully with all company procedures, processes, and policies
  • Partner with business leaders to understand business goals
  • Ensure SOP guides are being utilised and team members are in compliance
  • Onboarding of new team members, training and introduction to the resource library


What are we looking for?


  • Proven experience managing high-volume recruitment or sourcing projects, ensuring timely delivery and quality outcomes.
  • Minimum of 2–3 years’ experience in a people management role, leading a team of 5–10 or more recruiters/sourcers.
  • Strong background in Manufacturing, Chemical, or Oil & Gas (O&G) sectors, with proven expertise in managing talent acquisition or account delivery within these industries.
  • Experience supporting recruitment or account delivery across multiple countries , including Brazil and other international markets.
  • Fluent in English
  • Demonstrable track record in agency and/or onsite recruitment, preferably within the manufacturing and chemical sector
  • Strong team management
  • Broad exposure to recruitment ATS platforms
  • Strong working knowledge of sourcing tools, channels, and networking opportunities in your chosen markets of expertise
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Reliable and well organised
  • Team player with a flexible and confident approach to work
  • Ability to negotiate effectively
  • Ability to influence people, sell ideas and concepts and gain commitment
  • Customer focused

title: Analista de Melhoria Contínua Pleno
description:
Principais Atividades:

  • Acompanhar testes, homologações e coleta de aceite dos usuários e stakeholders.
  • Atuar como ponto focal de Operações nos projetos e implantações de novos produtos, defendendo os interesses da área e apoiando a governança estabelecida.
  • Estimular conversas construtivas e propor melhorias contínuas em processos, pessoas e cultura organizacional.


O que te torna ideal para essa vaga:

  • Formação superior completa;
  • Habilidade em análise de dados (Data Driven), visão crítica e conclusões baseado em fatos em dados.
  • Desejavel experiência com projetos ou melhorias que envolvam automações de processos (RPA, OCR, Analytics, etc.)
  • Vivência em melhoria contínua e mapeamento de processos. Desejável formação Lean Six Sigma Green Belt ou Similar.
  • Experiência em gestão de projetos (serviços ou indústria). Conhecimento em metodologias tradicionais (Waterfall) e ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).
  • Pacote Office: Excel, Word e PowerPoint Avançado para análise de dados e apresentações.
  • Diferencial: inglês ou espanhol intermediário.


A Seguradora para um mundo em mudança


Somos líder mundial em alianças do setor de bancasseguros e seguros de proteção de crédito, com presença em 33 países e posições fortes em três regiões: Europa, Ásia e América Latina. Com mais de 8.000 mil funcionários no mundo todo.


A BNP Paribas Cardif tem um papel essencial na vida dos clientes segurados, fornecendo soluções econômicas que permitem a realização de objetivos com a proteção contra eventos inesperados. Como uma empresa comprometida, a BNP Paribas Cardif se esforça para ter um impacto positivo na sociedade e contribuir para que os seguros sejam acessíveis ao maior número de pessoas possível.


No Brasil, somos uma das maiores especialistas em seguros massificados. Temos um portfólio de produtos diversificado, com destaque para: prestamista, garantia estendida (inclusive veicular), roubo e furto qualificado de portáveis com quebra acidental.


Somos uma seguradora B2B2C, ou seja, temos um modelo de negócio baseado em parcerias, em que nossos seguros são distribuídos para os clientes por meio da rede de grandes empresas brasileiras, divididas nos principais mercados: VAREJO, BANCOS e DIGITAL.


Venha trabalhar com a gente e vamos, juntos, tornar os seguros mais acessíveis à população brasileira!

title: Senior HRBP LATAM
description:
We're conducting a search for a Strategic Regional Talent Partner with 10+ years of progressive HR experience, an essential and proven focus on the Latin American (LATAM) region, and fluency in Portuguese and English with good verbal communication in Spanish.

This role works very closely with the C level (VP and Director level), influencing the business and translating business objectives into effective people and talent strategies. Will drive and implement global HR initiatives across key Latin American markets and addressing the unique challenges of the region.

This is a strategic and consultancy-focused role, dedicated to high-level partnering.


Key Areas of Accountability & Impact


The Strategic Regional Talent Partner is expected to drive results across three primary domains:


1. Strategic Business Partnership & Consulting


  • Executive Guidance: Serve as the primary HR advisor to senior regional executives, translating complex business objectives into actionable people plans
  • Performance Optimization: Provide expert counsel on maximizing business unit performance
  • Global Integration: Act as the regional conduit, collaborating with global Centers of Expertise (CoE) to ensure global people initiatives are effectively localized and deployed across LATAM markets.


2. Talent Management & Program Execution


  • High-Level Program Support: Directly advise and support senior leaders during critical annual organizational cycles
  • Capability Building: Partner with business leaders to identify and close critical skill gaps
  • Stakeholder Alignment: Facilitate the integration of talent programs across the business streams, working with cross-functional HR teams


3. Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement


  • Process Enhancement: Champion a continuous improvement mindset, actively soliciting feedback from the leadership population to refine HR processes and knowledge resources.
  • Service Model Efficiency: Effectively triage executive requests, leveraging a deep knowledge of the shared services model
  • Knowledge Leadership: Contribute to the overall organizational knowledge base and foster active knowledge sharing across the global HR community.


Required Experience, Skills, & Qualifications


Experience & Educational Foundation

  • Experience: 10+ years of progressive HR experience, with a minimum of 4+ years in a senior HR Business Partnering or strategic advisory role spanning multiple LATAM countries .
  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related field is highly desired.
  • Context: Proven ability to operate successfully within a complex, matrixed global organization utilizing an HR shared services delivery model.

Critical Competencies

  • Business Acumen: Possesses robust business knowledge (industry trends, competitors, market position)
  • Executive Influence: Exceptional ability to build trust, influence senior leaders (VP/Director), .
  • Bilingual Capability: Fluent English is mandatory. Proficiency in Spanish and/or Portuguese is highly desirable.
  • Agility & Judgment: Demonstrates high levels of resilience, adaptability, and critical thinking to navigate ambiguity, manage high-pressure situations, and exercise sound judgment.
  • Technical Familiarity: Experience with leading HRIS platforms (e.g., Workday ) and service management tools (e.g., ServiceNow ) is preferred.

Other Requirements

  • Flexibility: Willingness to accommodate business needs across different time zones (LATAM and North America).

title: FBS Sr Product Designer
description:
Our Client is one of the United States’ largest insurers, providing a wide range of insurance and financial services products with gross written premiums well over US$25 Billion (P&C). They proudly serve more than 10 million U.S. households with more than 19 million individual policies across all 50 states through the efforts of over 48,000 exclusive and independent agents and nearly 18,500 employees. Finally, our Client is part of one the largest Insurance Groups in the world.


About the Role

Farmers hiring a Senior User Experience (UX) Designer to join the Farmers Customer Experience Team, a multidisciplinary group that combines the power of human-centered and data-driven approaches to create end-to-end omni-channel experiences that enhance customer satisfaction, streamline operations, and deliver business impact.

This role drives strategic design by deeply understanding current user experiences, identifying opportunities, and envisioning future-state solutions. It leads the creation of effective user experiences through advanced UX principles and strategic thinking while independently delivering design solutions, collaborating with stakeholders, and contributing to evolving design systems.

The ideal candidate would have already achieved a senior level of UX and digital product design proficiency (including the associated tools, collaboration skills, and understanding of technology) and is now looking to grow by applying that experience strategically within the broader context of Customer Experience and Service Design.


Key Responsabilities


  • Plans and facilitates workshops and design sprints to establish alignment, understand business objectives, develop concepts, and chart strategic paths forward.
  • Contributes to user research efforts interviews, surveys, usability testing, A/B tests, and competitive evaluations to uncover behaviors, motivations, and pain points. Collaborates with Journey Owners and research teams to define target audiences and goals.
  • Maps user journeys, workflows, and service touchpoints to identify pain points and opportunities.
  • Applies insights to recommend UX improvements, validate decisions, and develop design concepts that balance user needs with business objectives.
  • Creates wireframes, mockups, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs to explore, communicate, and document solutions.
  • Tests and refines layouts, user interfaces, interaction patterns, and system components to ensure consistency and quality. Develops clear documentation and specifications to enable seamless implementation and guide development processes. Supports the evolution of design systems by evaluating and updating components to promote scalability and reusability.
  • Collaborates with product teams, development teams, and stakeholders to define requirements and co-create solutions. Participates in planning sessions and design reviews to facilitate implementation of features and functionality as designed.
  • Keeps stakeholders informed on goals, expectations, and timelines throughout the design process. Leads meetings effectively and presents with polish, using advanced storytelling and presentation skills to convey context, design concepts and rationale through a compelling narrative.
  • Conducts post-launch design evaluations to assess effectiveness of the design work, identify usability issues, recommend refinements, and measure impact.
  • Accepts and incorporates feedback to improve performance and work quality while knowing when to change direction or stay the course.
  • Seeks out opportunities to advance design skills by staying informed on trends, tools, and best practices in user experience. Actively explores and appropriately integrates AI tools into the design workflow.
  • Mentors less experienced team members to develop skills while providing feedback they seek and value.

Requirements

  • Minimum three years of experience required in user experience (UX) design, product design, or related field.
  • Bachelors degree preferred
  • Tools: Figma, Mural/Miro, Rally/Jira, Office Suite
  • Deep understanding of UX principles, usability, and product design.
  • Familiarity with customer journey mapping and service blueprinting.
  • Strong communication and facilitation skills; able to present ideas clearly and confidently.
  • Effective collaboration and conflict resolution abilities.
  • Excellent time management and project prioritization skills.
  • Experience with agile methodologies and product management practices.
  • Proficiency in design tools like Figma, Mural/Miro, and Microsoft Office.
  • Basic knowledge of front-end development concepts.
  • Strong storytelling and presentation capabilities.

Benefits

This position comes with competitive compensation and benefits package:

  1. Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses
  2. Comprehensive benefits package
  3. Career development and training opportunities
  4. Flexible work arrangements (remote and/or office-based)
  5. Dynamic and inclusive work culture within a globally renowned group
  6. Private Health Insurance
  7. Pension Plan
  8. Paid Time Off
  9. Training & Development

The role typically requires working in an office environment, with the possibility of remote work depending on the organization’s policies. The Operations Manager may need to be available during peak hours to oversee operations and support staff.

title: Técnico de qualidade
description:
A SYSTRA é um dos principais grupos de engenharia e consultoria do mundo, especialista em transporte público e mobilidade sustentável. Com mais de 11.000 colaboradores, nossa missão é projetar soluções seguras e inovadoras que aproximem pessoas, promovam inclusão social e facilitem o acesso ao emprego, à educação e ao lazer em todo o mundo.


Há mais de 65 anos, o Grupo atua ao lado de cidades e regiões para desenvolver, modernizar e operar infraestruturas e sistemas de transporte, acompanhando todas as fases do ciclo de vida dos projetos. Estamos presentes em mais de 80 países, incluindo o Brasil, que conta com mais de 800 colaboradores.


No Brasil, nossa história começa nos anos 1960, com estudos para a modernização da rede ferroviária e as primeiras análises para implantação de metrôs. Nas décadas seguintes, participamos de projetos que viabilizaram metrôs, VLTs, BRTs e rodovias.


A SYSTRA Brasil entrega soluções completas em todas as etapas: estudos, desenvolvimento de projetos, gerenciamento e fiscalização. Hoje, também apoiamos nossos clientes e parceiros na transição digital, ecológica e energética, sempre com foco na mobilidade do futuro.

Para maiores informações acesse


Na SYSTRA, além de contribuir com conhecimento e ideias inovadoras, você terá a oportunidade de trabalhar em um time de referência global, conectado por um propósito comum: transformar a mobilidade com excelência, audácia e colaboração. Aqui, você terá contato com diversos projetos de mobilidade e infraestrutura de transportes, em um ambiente que valoriza o aprendizado contínuo e o desenvolvimento de cada profissional.


A confiança transporta o mundo, e para nós isso significa criar um ambiente onde todas as pessoas possam pertencer e crescer. Nossas vagas são inclusivas e abertas à diversidade de talentos que movem a mobilidade do futuro.


Principais Atividades:


  • Acompanhar a execução das atividades em campo, verificando a conformidade dos processos e serviços executados em relação aos padrões de qualidade estabelecidos;
  • Realizar inspeções e testes de materiais, produtos e serviços, registrando os resultados em relatórios específicos;

  • Auxiliar na elaboração, revisão e atualização de documentos da qualidade, como procedimentos, instruções de trabalho, planos de inspeção e ensaios;
  • Participar de reuniões e treinamentos sobre qualidade e normas aplicáveis à obra;
  • Controlar a calibração e manutenção dos equipamentos e instrumentos utilizados nas inspeções;
  • Manter registros organizados e atualizados de todas as atividades de controle da qualidade;
  • Apoiar auditorias internas e externas na obra, acompanhando os auditores e fornecendo evidências solicitadas.


Requisitos:

title: Broadcast Specialist/Coordinator
description:
About Garena:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore , Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.


Garena provides global users access to popular and engaging mobile and PC online games that it develops, curates, and localizes. It champions games as a social and entertainment platform on which its communities can engage and interact.


In addition, Garena is a leading esports organizer. It hosts esports events around the world that range from grassroots local tournaments to some of the most viewed professional esports competitions globally. The Free Fire World Series 2021 Singapore, which was watched by 5.4 million concurrent viewers at its peak, holds the record for the highest concurrent viewership of any esports match in history.


About the position:

We are looking for a Broadcast Specialist/Coordinator who will be responsible for leading the planning, execution, and optimization of all broadcast and content initiatives within Free Fire Esports. This role combines production, storytelling, and digital strategy expertise to deliver world-class esports broadcasts and high-impact content that enhance the fan experience. The Broadcast & Content Specialist/Coordinator acts as a bridge between internal teams, external vendors, influencers, and regional stakeholders to ensure creative alignment, operational excellence, and consistent brand storytelling across all tournaments and platforms.


Make sure to share your CV in English.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead the full broadcast and content pipeline for Free Fire Esports — from pre-production planning to live execution and post-event content delivery.
  • Manage relationships with broadcast vendors, studios, and creative agencies, ensuring adherence to Garena’s quality standards, deadlines, and budget.
  • Supervise on-site production during tournaments, overseeing show flow, run-down execution, and coordination between technical, talent, and content teams.
  • Drive the creative direction of tournament broadcasts, including narrative development, talent integration, segment design, and audience interaction.
  • Collaborate closely with Marketing and Social Media teams to align content distribution plans, ensuring maximum reach and engagement across all digital channels.
  • Oversee the development of post-production deliverables (recaps, highlights, interviews, documentaries, etc.), ensuring consistency in tone, pacing, and storytelling.
  • Analyze viewership and engagement data to inform future broadcast and content strategies, identifying performance trends and improvement opportunities.
  • Support marketing teams with guidelines and toolkits to ensure global consistency of broadcast quality and messaging.
  • Manage the internal review process for scripts, visual assets, and show rundowns, ensuring narrative cohesion and compliance with brand standards.
  • Stay ahead of emerging broadcast technologies, formats, and fan engagement tools to continuously evolve Free Fire Esports’ viewing experience.



Main job requirements:

  • Education: Completed higher education. Desirable in Communication, Broadcasting, Media Production, or related fields.
  • Experience: 6+ years in esports broadcast production, live event coordination, or content operations.
  • Proven track record leading complex, large-scale broadcast projects with multiple stakeholders and external vendors.
  • Strong understanding of esports ecosystems, gaming audiences, and live content dynamics.
  • Experience managing creative and technical production teams (e.g., camera crew, stage talent, editors, motion designers).
  • Solid analytical skills and ability to translate viewership metrics into actionable insights.
  • Excellent project management, communication, and vendor negotiation skills.
  • Portfolio demonstrating successful execution of esports or entertainment broadcasts and digital content initiatives.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese (written and spoken).
  • Available to work in person at our office in São Paulo, SP.
  • Preferred: Previous experience with international esports tournaments or live entertainment events. Familiarity with OBS, vMix, or other live production software, and knowledge of streaming infrastructure. Comfortable working under high-pressure live event conditions

This role is responsible for designing and implementing visual assets for in-app and offline campaigns, ensuring brand consistency while adapting content to the Brazilian audience and local culture.


Responsibilities

Create landing pages, banners, and in-app assets for campaigns.

Develop visual identities for major projects, aligning with brand and local audience.

Adapt campaigns and pages for the Brazilian market.

Design offline and cross-media materials to expand brand presence.

Act as point of contact for visual suggestions and adjustments.

Produce key visuals for local projects; occasionally support video/motion design.

Collaborate with teams and external agencies to coordinate deliverables.

Provide real-time design support for in-app operations.

Upload visuals to the internal publisher of HTML pages, ensuring accurate insertion and updates of content.


Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Design, Visual Communication, or related field.

Experience in digital design, landing pages, and campaign visuals.

Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, etc.) or equivalent tools.

Knowledge or experience with social media content and campaigns.

Strong knowledge of composition, typography, and branding.

Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.

Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

Intermediate to advanced English.


Nice to Have

Experience with motion graphics or video editing.

Cross-media campaigns experience.

Understanding of localization for global campaigns.

Familiarity with real-time design support.

Experience with Figma and UX principles.

Previous experience working in apps or digital platforms.

description:

title: Consultor de Viagens VIP Bilingue
description:

Nós confiamos que nossos serviços terão sempre qualidade, oferecemos agilidade nos serviços e soluções desenvolvidas. Inovamos em cada projeto e estabelecemos relações humanas acolhedoras com clientes, colaboradores e fornecedores.

Conheça também nossas unidades de negócios: Viagens corporativas, Eventos e Incentivos, Lazer, Tecnologia e Câmbio.

Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você fazer parte do nosso time! Buscamos alguém apaixonado pelo universo das viagens e que compreenda o impacto do seu trabalho no sucesso do negócio.


Principais atividades


  • Atuar com excelência no atendimento a clientes VIPs, assegurando uma experiência exclusiva e personalizada em todas as etapas da viagem, nacional e internacional;
  • Assumir a posição de floater, cobrindo férias e ausências dos consultores fixos no atendimento aos clientes VIPs de diferentes contas corporativas, garantindo continuidade e qualidade no serviço;
  • Realizar reservas e emissões de passagens, hospedagens e demais serviços com atenção especial às preferências, hábitos e expectativas do cliente VIP;
  • Aplicar profundo conhecimento das políticas de viagem, protocolos de segurança e conveniências específicas, garantindo decisões ágeis e estratégicas;

  • Negociar com fornecedores buscando benefícios exclusivos, upgrades e serviços personalizados;
  • Gerenciar imprevistos com diplomacia e eficiência, garantindo tranquilidade ao cliente em qualquer situação;
  • Monitorar continuamente a jornada do cliente, oferecendo suporte de ponta a ponta com alto padrão de qualidade;
  • Zelar pelo sigilo e segurança das informações e preferências dos clientes VIPs;
  • Atuar alinhado à estratégia da AVIPAM, valorizando a reputação da empresa como referência em atendimento diferenciado e premium.


Requisitos


  • Graduação completa em Turismo ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência comprovada em agências de viagens ou TMC, com foco em atendimento corporativo VIP;
  • Sólido conhecimento e experiência prática em (GDS) Sabre e Amadeus e ferramentas de reservas online (OBT) Argo e Lemontech;
  • Proficiência no uso dos portais de companhias aéreas;

Contrato: CLT

Atuação Híbrida após 3 meses de contratação.

title: Analista de Produção Web Júnior
description:

Fazendo a verificação se o material está dentro do nosso padrão, resolvendo pendências de falta de informações com as marcas e time comercial, atuando nas descrições e categorizações dos produtos, clonando referências, criando vitrines, atualizando o preço e estoque e fazendo o load da campanha.

As entregas precisam de um olhar analítico para informações essenciais com foco na entrega qualitativa, seguindo o briefing da marca e negociando novas possibilidades de se criar uma campanha atrativa para nossos consumidores (inclui pesquisa no site da marca e benchmarks para garantir que estamos ofertando da forma mais completa possível.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Análise dos materiais enviados pelas marcas (excel e imagem);
  • Análise e geração dos KPI’s de qualidade;
  • Análise do briefing da campanha;
  • Análise das descrições via I.A;
  • Contato direto com as marcas para resolver pendências de falta de material/informações obrigatórias;
  • Contato e negociação de prazos com o time comercial;
  • Clonar referências/campanhas;
  • Descrever os produtos da campanha;
  • Pesquisar informações dos produtos no site oficial da marca e em demais;
  • Subir as imagens no site;
  • Criação da vitrine (product order);
  • Atualização do preço e estoque;
  • Load da campanha no sistema interno;
  • Abrir chamados de risco e acompanhamento pós-load.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Graduação completa ou cursando em: Design, Publicidade e Propaganda, Administração ou em cursos correlatos;
  • Conhecimento intermediário/avançado em Excel;
  • Interesse em trabalhar com o segmento de moda e lifestyle, além de trabalhar com e-commerce.


O que oferecemos?

Além de um clima descontraído, sem política de dress code e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:

title: Head of FP&A
description:
Sinch is looking for a talented Head of FP&A to join us in Sao Paulo! The Director will serve as a key strategic partner to the Senior Leadership Team in Latin America, leading the overall financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and performance analysis functions for the organization in Brazil. The Director will report to the VP of FP&A - Americas located in the United States.

This leadership role is responsible for translating business strategy into financial plans, providing data-driven insights to support critical decision-making, and driving operational efficiency and financial performance improvements. The Director will also be responsible for managing, mentoring, and developing a highly performing FP&A team.


Sinch is a global customer engagement platform that provides communication services for businesses across messaging, voice, and email. Sinch's services are used by more than 150,000 businesses, including many of the world's largest tech companies.


Responsibilities

Financial Analysis and Reporting:

  • Direct the preparation of timely, accurate, and insightful management reports (e.g., Monthly/Quarterly Business Review packages) for the Senior Leadership Team in LatAm
  • Conduct in-depth variance analysis on financial performance (Actuals vs. Budget/Forecast/Prior Year), identifying key trends, opportunities, and risks, and clearly articulating the 'story behind the numbers.'
  • Own and manage the reporting of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), ensuring metrics are relevant and drive accountability across the organization.
  • Collaborate with the Accounting and Controllership teams to ensure accurate financial data consolidation and reporting in compliance with local BR GAAP and international standards (e.g., IFRS/US GAAP, if applicable).
  • Prepare compelling financial presentations and reports for executive leadership, and other stakeholders


Strategic Planning, Budgeting, and Forecasting:

  • Lead the comprehensive annual planning (Budget) and long-range planning (LRP) processes for Latin America, primarily in Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, ensuring alignment with corporate strategic goals.
  • Manage the quarterly financial forecasting process, incorporating business drivers, market trends, and operational changes to ensure high accuracy and predictability.
  • Develop complex financial models (e.g., scenario analysis, sensitivity analysis) to evaluate new business initiatives, and strategic projects.


Business Partnering and Stakeholder Management:

  • Act as the primary finance partner to the General Manager - LatAm and other functional leaders (Sales, Marketing, Operations), providing financial advice and challenging assumptions.
  • Present financial results, forecasts, and strategic recommendations clearly and persuasively to executive management.
  • Drive continuous improvement in cost management and resource allocation, recommending actions to optimize profitability and operational efficiency.


Team Leadership and Development:

  • Manage, coach, mentor, and motivate a team of FP&A professionals, fostering a culture of high performance, analytical rigor, and professional growth.
  • Define team goals, allocate resources efficiently, and manage workflows to ensure all deliverables are met accurately and on time.
  • Lead efforts to streamline and automate FP&A processes and systems to improve efficiency and data integrity.



Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field. MBA degree highly desirable.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in financial planning and analysis (FP&A), public accounting, investment banking, or private equity; with a strong focus on operational expenses, and preferably with a large multinational corporation.
  • A minimum of 3+ years of experience managing a team of financial professionals.
  • Experience with financial planning and reporting software (Anaplan, AARO), ERP systems, CRM systems (Salesforce), and Visual Reporting (Tableau) highly preferred.
  • Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills
  • Proven ability to synthesize complex financial data into clear and concise insights for non-financial stakeholders.
  • Excellent communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships across the organization.
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Previous experience in finance within a technology or telecommunications environment would be advantageous
  • Fluency in English (verbal and written) is required for effective communication with international leadership.
  • Fluency in Spanish desirable but not required.

title: Professor
description:
IMK, escola de educação infantil bilíngue localizada no Alto de Pinheiros em São Paulo, procura professora Montessori para sala de 3-6 (Primary)


Responsabilidades:


Gestão do Ambiente Preparado:

  • Preparar e manter meticulosamente um ambiente de aprendizagem Montessori que seja seguro, acessível, organizado, limpo e esteticamente agradável.
  • Garantir que todos os materiais pedagógicos estejam completos, em perfeito estado de conservação e dispostos de forma lógica e atraente.
  • Realizar a rotação de materiais conforme a observação das necessidades e interesses do grupo.
  • Criar uma atmosfera de calma, ordem e respeito mútuo na sala.

Observação e Planejamento Pedagógico:

  • Observar ativamente as crianças em seu trabalho, registrando seu progresso, interesses, desafios e desenvolvimento social, emocional e acadêmico.
  • Utilizar as observações diárias para planejar lições individualizadas e em pequenos grupos, respeitando o ritmo único de cada criança.
  • Manter registros detalhados e precisos do desenvolvimento de cada aluno para acompanhar seu progresso e compartilhar com os pais e a coordenação.

Apresentação de Lições e Orientação (O Papel de "Guia"):

  • Apresentar os materiais e conceitos Montessori (Vida Prática, Sensorial, Linguagem, Matemática e Áreas Culturais) de forma clara, precisa e cativante.
  • Atuar como "Guia", conectando a criança ao material e protegendo seu ciclo de trabalho e concentração, intervindo o mínimo necessário.
  • Estimular a independência, a autodisciplina, a resolução de problemas e o pensamento crítico.
  • Não corrigir o erro da criança diretamente, mas sim guiá-la para que ela mesma o perceba e aprenda com ele.

Desenvolvimento Social e Emocional:

  • Fomentar um ambiente de comunidade e colaboração entre as crianças de idades mistas.
  • Modelar e ensinar ativamente "Graça e Cortesia", orientando as crianças na resolução de conflitos, comunicação respeitosa e habilidades sociais.
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento da autoestima, confiança e empatia de cada criança.

Comunicação e Colaboração:

  • Estabelecer e manter uma comunicação regular, transparente e positiva com os pais/responsáveis, compartilhando o progresso da criança e fortalecendo a parceria escola-família.
  • Preparar e conduzir reuniões de pais e conferências individuais.
  • Colaborar ativamente com a assistente de sala, coordenação pedagógica e demais membros da equipe escolar.
  • Participar de reuniões de equipe, eventos escolares e oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional contínuo.


Requisitos e Qualificações

Formação Essencial:

  • Formação Superior: Graduação completa em Pedagogia ou áreas afins (Psicologia, Letras) com a devida complementação pedagógica.
  • Certificação Montessori: Formação (Curso de Especialização) no Método Montessori específica para a faixa etária de 3 a 6 anos (Casa dei Bambini), emitida por uma instituição reconhecida (como AMI, AMS, OMB ou equivalentes).
  • Fluência ou nível avançado em Inglês (para escolas bilíngues).

Experiência Exigida:

  • Experiência prévia comprovada atuando no Método Montessori em um ambiente de 3 a 6 anos.
  • Vivência prática na apresentação de todo o currículo Montessori (Vida Prática, Sensorial, Linguagem, Matemática e Áreas Culturais) para esta faixa etária.

Habilidades e Competências:

  • Profundo Conhecimento: Compreensão sólida da filosofia Montessori e das teorias de desenvolvimento infantil.
  • Capacidade de Observação: Habilidade aguçada para observar a criança de forma científica e neutra, identificando suas necessidades e interesses.
  • Comunicação: Excelente habilidade de comunicação verbal e escrita, para interagir de forma clara e respeitosa com crianças, pais e colegas de equipe.
  • Inteligência Emocional: Postura calma, paciente, empática e resiliente, sabendo manejar os desafios da sala de aula com equilíbrio.
  • Organização e Planejamento: Forte senso de organização para a manutenção do ambiente e para o planejamento pedagógico individualizado.
  • Proatividade: Capacidade de agir como um(a) facilitador(a) dinâmico(a), em vez de um(a) instrutor(a) diretivo(a).
  • Trabalho em Equipe: Habilidade para colaborar efetivamente com a assistente de sala e demais membros da escola.

Diferenciais (Desejável, mas não obrigatório):

  • Habilidades em artes, música ou movimento.
  • Experiência com crianças com necessidades educacionais especiais (inclusão).
  • Conhecimento em Comunicação Não-Violenta (CNV) ou Disciplina Positiva.

title: Analista de processos
description:
Venha para uma das maiores empresas de Serviços TI do mundo!! Aqui você pode transformar sua carreira! Por que fazer parte da TCS? Aqui na TCS acreditamos que as pessoas fazem a diferença, por isso vivemos uma cultura de aprendizado ilimitado cheio de oportunidades de melhorias e desenvolvimento mútuo.
